spec_family.name: Exterior Wood Siding Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish coat painting for exterior wood siding. Covers full prep (mill glaze removal, back-prime, end-seal, knot treatment, caulk), field prime, and two finish coats. Handles all exterior wood substrate states from new construction bare wood through repaint scenarios. Uses SF as primary UOM. Application method options: spray, spray with backroll, or brush/roll. Siding profile dimension (lap, board-and-batten, shingle) drives rate modifiers and coverage profiles. Access type drives height modifier. Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in window/door specs.

includes: Siding field surface preparation (sand, scrape, wash per substrate state)
Mill glaze removal on new bare wood
Back-priming rear/hidden siding faces (NC bare wood)
End-sealing all cut edges (NC bare wood)
Caulking siding-to-trim joints and board joints
Fixture and utility masking (light fixtures, HVAC, hose bibs)

excludes.route_to: Window spec (RC-001: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.item: Door masking, hardware protection, and glass protection
excludes.route_to: Door spec (RC-001: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.item: Exterior trim painting (corner boards, frieze, rake, window/door casing)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard production. QT4=premium (systematic inspect, interstage sand). QT5=superior (thorough inspect at arm's length, full interstage). Coat count is 1 prime + 2 finish at ALL tiers.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is fastest but requires full protection setup. Spray_backroll provides best film adhesion on wood. Brush_roll is slowest but requires minimal protection.

configuration_dimensions.description: Siding profile type. Drives production rate modifiers and coverage profiles.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Lap horizontal is baseline. Board-and-batten has ~20% more effective surface area. Shingle has ~50% more due to overlapping edges. Per Exterior_Wood_Siding_Systems_Doctrine.

paintable_items.name: Siding Field
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable siding field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim boards. Measured per elevation.
paintable_items.notes: Primary and only paintable item. SF is net area from PaintScope. Profile modifier adjusts effective surface area for production rates and coverage.

variants.notes: Standard spray production on lap siding. Fastest production. Full landscape/hardscape protection for overspray.
Standard spray+backroll on lap siding. Best film adhesion. Recommended for new bare wood.
Standard brush/roll on lap siding. Reduced protection scope — no full landscape cover needed.
Premium spray+backroll. Interstage sanding included. Systematic inspection at 6 ft.
Superior spray+backroll. Full interstage. Thorough inspection at arm's length from scaffold.
Standard production on board-and-batten. 1.20x profile modifier on application tasks.
Standard production on shingle siding. 1.50x profile modifier. Backroll essential for coverage in overlapping edges.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Access type per elevation (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift) — drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When landscape is adjacent to siding
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Landscape protection area within 4 ft of siding

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: application_method = spray and landscape beyond 4 ft
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Extended landscape protection for spray overspray zone

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When walkways are adjacent to siding
When patio is adjacent to siding
When exterior fixtures are present on siding elevations
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of light fixtures to mask

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When HVAC units are adjacent to siding
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of HVAC units to cover

protection_zones_required.notes: Plantings within 4 ft. Edge tarps for brush/roll, full cover for spray.
Extended overspray zone beyond 4 ft. Spray only.
All exterior fixtures on working elevations.
HVAC units adjacent to siding. Full tarp cover.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Soffit at eave line. Different color typically. Separate scope.
Frieze board at siding-to-soffit or siding-to-foundation junction. Not on every project. Trim color. Separate scope.
Corner boards frame siding. Trim color. Siding terminates at corner — no blend.
Window casing. Siding terminates at casing. Window/door protection is window/door spec's responsibility (RC-001).
Door casing. Same as window casing relationship.
Foundation below siding or frieze. Not painted.

valid_input_states.notes: Handles full range of exterior wood substrate states. NC bare wood is the primary case. Repaint and stain-overcoat scenarios also supported. Prep module activates conditional tasks based on input state.

output_state.notes: Output is always SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT regardless of sheen — exterior paint states don't differentiate by sheen.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed at elevation (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate ÷ modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Access type is a height modifier (like FAC_HEIGHT for interior), NOT a site condition (RC-004). Estimatable and predictable from project scope.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Prep → Prime → Finish 1 → Interstage → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Siding terminates at trim boards — no cut-in or blending across specs.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection → Fixture masking → Equipment setup → Coating work → Protection teardown → Equipment cleanup → Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (substrate-state-driven) → Prime (1 coat) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage (inspect, sand QT4+, touch up) → Finish coat 2 → Final inspect → Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Follow shade for optimal conditions.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door specs, not this spec (RC-001). If windows/doors are in scope, their specs handle glass/hardware masking. If not in scope, protection is a separate mobilization.
relationships.notes: First exterior spec. Combined prime+paint. Future exterior specs: SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_PAINT, SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC_PAINT.

research_corrections.original_claim: Window glass and door glass are protection zones for siding spec
research_corrections.corrected_to: Window/door protection belongs in window/door specs. Siding spec covers landscape, hardscape, and fixture protection only.

research_corrections.original_claim: Fascia is adjacent to siding field
research_corrections.corrected_to: Fascia is part of soffit system. Soffit and frieze board are the correct upper/lower adjacencies.

research_corrections.original_claim: Wind, surface temp, dew point, sun exposure should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

research_corrections.original_claim: Access type is a site condition
research_corrections.corrected_to: Access type is a HEIGHT MODIFIER, not a site condition.
Include all exterior wood substrate states for full coverage.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior wood siding prime and paint. FIRST EXTERIOR SPEC — validates exterior domain dispatch pipeline. Key features: combined prime+paint (single mobilization), 9 substrate states from NC bare wood through repaint, 3 siding profiles (lap/board-and-batten/shingle), 3 application methods (spray/spray_backroll/brush_roll), 3 quality tiers, 31 tasks across 8 modules (equipment setup split into spray/brush variants), 3 primer systems (acrylic/tannin-blocking/bonding), 3 finish systems (standard/premium/superior), 3 factor modifiers (access/substrate/profile). 5 research corrections applied. 3 QA issues resolved. Environmental conditions excluded from estimation. Window/door protection excluded (owned by surface specs).
